[[File:Cognitive overload.png|thumbnail|[[The widening context]] is believed to contribute to occurrence of '''cognitive overload'''.<ref>{{#cite:Q2791}}</ref>]]
According to [[cognitive load theory]], '''cognitive overload''' describes the mental state in which one's [[working memory]] has been exceeded, hampering understanding and learning.<ref>{{#cite:Q3005}}</ref>
